body: The second key glints in the dim light from the hallway. The board buzzes under my fingers as I gingerly reach for it. My heart pounds, each beat echoing the pounding in my veins. Panic rises like fog, choking me. I try to pull out a camera phone, but my shaking hands refuse to cooperate.
